title: Airboat vs Kayak, Side by Side
why: Cold-to-warm visitors choosing a swamp tour type: an honest side-by-side against the airboat (no competitor named), including who should pick the airboat.
hook_options: Propeller or paddle? Pick before you book.
Airboat vs kayak: six honest differences.
caption: Airboat or kayak? Both get you into a Louisiana swamp. One is fast and loud, the other is slow and close. Similar price range. Here's the honest side-by-side, including when the airboat is the better call. #SwampTour #NewOrleans #Airboat #KayakTour

slides.headline: Propeller or paddle? Pick before you book.
slides.body: No company names. Just what changes when you swap an engine for a paddle.

slides.headline: Airboat: ear protection. Kayak: birdsong.
slides.body: An airboat runs an aircraft-style propeller. On a kayak the loudest sounds are paddle drips and your guide.

slides.headline: Engines scatter animals. Silence doesn't.
slides.body: From a kayak you can watch a gator stay on its log. Some tours bait gators. We never feed wildlife.

slides.headline: Airboats cover miles. Kayaks go narrow.
slides.body: A fast boat sees more water. A kayak slips into side channels and under low cypress a big boat can't reach.

slides.headline: A bench of strangers, or 12 max.
slides.body: Our public tours cap at 12 guests. Small enough to go quiet together and actually hear the place.

slides.headline: Airboat: none. Kayak: two easy hours.
slides.body: You do paddle. Flat water, stable kayaks, a lesson on shore. Most first-timers settle in fast.

slides.headline: Close enough to call it even.
slides.body: Area airboat rides run about $50 to $90 for 60 to 90 minutes. Our Manchac tour is $65 for 2 hours.

slides.headline: Mobility limits, little kids, need for speed.
slides.body: Real reasons. If paddling isn't right for your group, an airboat is a fine day out.

slides.headline: Speed and noise, or quiet and close.
slides.body: If watching animals act like animals matters to you, paddle. That's the whole difference.

slides.headline: Pick the paddle.
slides.body: Small-group kayak swamp tours from New Orleans. No motor, no bait, naturalist guides.
